services.name: DiagTrack
services.reason: Optional telemetry service. Disabling reduces diagnostic uploads on consumer PCs.

services.name: SysMain
services.reason: Can increase disk activity on HDDs. Keep Automatic on SSDs with light load if preferred.

services.name: WSearch
services.reason: Indexing can use CPU/disk. Only consider changing if you rarely use Start/search.

services.name: XblAuthManager
services.reason: Only needed for Xbox Live features and some Store games.

services.name: RemoteRegistry
services.reason: Remote registry access is rarely needed on personal PCs and increases attack surface.
